title: Can Abstract Interpretation Bound Neural Network Alignment Behavior?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if abstract interpretation produces informative bounds on toxicity over an input region, it demonstrates a concrete step toward formally verified deployed AI. This directly advances the formal verification agenda for neural network safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Abstract interpretation (interval arithmetic, zonotopes) on neural networks requires specialized knowledge of both formal methods and neural network internals. Even restricted to a 3-5 layer feedforward network, implementing zonotope propagation is non-trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused on one technique (abstract interpretation) applied to one property (toxicity bound) on one small network. This is well-scoped conceptually. But the implementation of abstract interpretation propagation is itself a significant engineering task.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
